name: Sagawa Midori
source:
A waitress who works part time at the tea shop and stand in the hospital. She wears a considerably special uniform that is popular among some enthusiasts. She always does things at her pace, but she is brimming with curiosity. If she becomes a little interested in something she will immediately stick her nose into it. Although she is unexpectedly a level-headed person, she has some careless points.

[Based on the [url=http://www.oaks-soft.co.jp/princess-soft/21twoone/21chara.html]official site[/url]]
